question: Can the revised rear-fasteners-first sequence admit each M2 nut while all M3 hardware and the other seven M2 nuts are already present?

motion.direction: Lower-Y row approaches from -Y; upper-Y row from +Y

criteria_origin: 0.05mm is an engineering nominal assembly-fit screen, not the 0.5mm free-part clearance and not guaranteed FDM capability; seated bearing contact is intended
stop: One continuous translation then seating sweep per nut; no path search. Report tolerance requirements separately from nominal passage.
limits: M2 screws absent during insertion; introduce afterward
Other seven M2 nuts are present at final seats to bound insertion-order interference
No hands/tweezers, print tolerances, burrs, friction, nut chamfers or tilted insertion
No free-standing retention before screw engagement
Includes existing body geometry conservatively but does not prove later whole rear-unit installation
